remarks: Welcome to 197 Park Slope! As you step through the front gate and onto the blue stone patio, this luxurious sun-drenched end unit delivers spaciousness and privacy of a single-family home with elegant living, complete with a marble fireplace, dining and den, that are enhanced by the beautifully appointed features of custom painted millwork, and pristine hardwood floors that flow seamlessly room to room. The heart of the home centers around a gourmet kitchen equipped with Viking appliances, granite countertops, and abundant cabinetry, plus a generous space for casual dining or entertaining. The impressive primary suite is a true retreat, complete with tray ceiling, and a sumptuous marble ensuite with separate shower, whirlpool bath, and custom walk-in closet. Two additional well-proportioned bedrooms share a stylish hall bath. The lower level extends living space with the convenience of your own 2 car garage, and an oversized laundry room, utility room, and additional ample storage. A Private Elevator operates on all three floors!  Walk to New Canaan Town Center for shopping, eclectic restaurants and Metro North Transportation.
